#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Eurostat loader - loads selected Eurostat-style indicators into normalized long format.
"""

import csv
import pandas as pd

def main():
    # Read selected indicators from T01 output
    selected_indicators = pd.read_csv('outputs/t01_selected_indicators.csv')
    selected_indicator_ids = set(selected_indicators['indicator_id'].tolist())
    
    # Read raw Eurostat city values data
    raw_data = pd.read_csv('inputs/eurostat/eurostat_city_values_sample.csv')
    
    # Filter to only include selected indicators
    filtered_data = raw_data[raw_data['indicator_id'].isin(selected_indicator_ids)]
    
    # Remove duplicate rows (same city_id, year, indicator_id)
    filtered_data = filtered_data.drop_duplicates(subset=['city_id', 'year', 'indicator_id'])
    
    # Select and order columns for output in required format
    output_columns = ['city_id', 'city_name', 'year', 'indicator_id', 'indicator_name', 'value', 'unit']
    output_data = filtered_data[output_columns]
    
    # Write to CSV with RFC 4180 compliance (quote fields with special characters)
    output_data.to_csv('outputs/t02_eurostat_raw.csv', index=False, quoting=csv.QUOTE_ALL)

if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
</solution_file>
